annotations.title: Qwen2.5 Coder 32B, code LLM API: pay per call, no API key

description: Chat with Alibaba's Qwen2.5 Coder 32B code model (Apache 2.0) through one paid HTTP call: send a prompt and an optional system prompt, get the answer, up to 1,024 output tokens. Also reachable as model "qwen-coder" on the OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions. No account or provider key. Use when an agent wants this model by name. Example: prompt=Explain x402 in one sentence.. Price $0.005/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

system.description: Optional system prompt, up to 2,000 characters
